reference.title: High pressure equation of state for solid argon from interatomic potentials

model_description: Monte Carlo pressure-volume isotherm using the Barker-Fisher-Watts pair potential and the Axilrod-Teller three-body interaction.
model_description_source: Primary abstract; no full-text equation or coefficients verified.
phase_status: Solid argon verified; precise simulated crystal structure not verified from full text.

experimental_comparison.note: The abstract's 800 kbar limit describes the experimental comparison; it is not an independently verified simulation or fitted validity range. No observations from Ross are relabeled as Barker measurements.

reproduction.note: Supporting-study outcome only. No surrogate fit, potential coefficients, model curves, measured points or uncertainties have been invented. This does not establish that the original calculation is irreproducible.
